subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this stack retain the Matrix-specific generic SDK calls and the coupled production Gateway admission change, or must those boundaries be narrowed before the scenario migration lands?
rationale: The branch is well proven as QA infrastructure, but deciding whether temporary Matrix glue becomes an SDK contract and whether a global lifecycle change belongs in this stack requires explicit owner intent rather than automated repair judgment.

options.title: Narrow the boundaries
options.body: Keep Matrix bridging inside QA Lab/QA Matrix package APIs and review the Gateway admission behavior separately with production lifecycle proof.

options.title: Approve the coupled design
options.body: Explicitly accept the Matrix-named SDK contract, global restart semantics, and exact dependency graph as intentional permanent boundaries.

recommendation.title: Narrow the boundaries
recommendation.body: Keep Matrix bridging inside QA Lab/QA Matrix package APIs and review the Gateway admission behavior separately with production lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the stacked Matrix QA direction and authored the merged predecessor, making them the best available coordinator for the cross-owner decision.
